pdftools.done: {what} applied. Undo (Ctrl+Z) to take it back.
pdftools.toolHint.redact: Drag over what to redact. Marked content is removed from the file when you apply. Esc to stop.
pdftools.toolHint.link: Drag the link area. Esc to stop.
pdftools.toolHint.field: Drag or click where the field goes. Esc to stop.
pdftools.toolHint.crop: Drag the area to keep. Esc to stop.
pdftools.toolHint.measure: Drag for a distance; click points for a perimeter or area, then double-click or press Enter. Esc to stop.
pdftools.toolHint.picture: Click the image to replace. Esc to stop.
pdftools.redact.title: Redact
pdftools.redact.sub: Removes the text, images and comments under the marks from the file itself: they cannot be copied or found afterwards.
pdftools.redact.areaTip: Drag over the page to mark what to redact
pdftools.redact.scrub: Also remove hidden information (author, metadata, attachments, scripts)
pdftools.redact.warn: Applying removes the marked content from the file. You can undo (Ctrl+Z) in Omniweave, but a saved file cannot get it back.
pdftools.redact.confirm: Remove the content of {n} marked areas from the file?
pdftools.redact.report: Redacted: {glyphs} characters, {images} images, {annots} comments removed. Searched words left: {left}
pdftools.wm.title: Watermark
pdftools.wm.sub: Places text or an image over (or behind) the pages.
pdftools.hf.title: Header & Footer
pdftools.hf.sub: Adds text, page numbers, dates or Bates numbers in six places at the top and bottom of the pages.
pdftools.bg.title: Background
pdftools.bg.sub: Puts a color or an image behind the page content.
pdftools.bm.title: Bookmarks
pdftools.bm.sub: Make bookmarks and edit their names, order, levels and pages. Applying replaces the file's bookmarks.
pdftools.bm.fromTocDone: {n} bookmarks made. Check them and press Apply.
pdftools.bm.name: Bookmark name
pdftools.link.title: Link
pdftools.link.sub: Clicking the drawn area goes to another page or a web address.
pdftools.link.draw: First drag an area on the page with the Link tool.
pdftools.field.title: Form Field
pdftools.field.sub: Creates a form field in the area drawn on the page.
pdftools.field.name: Name
pdftools.field.label: Button label
pdftools.field.draw: First drag an area on the page with the Add Field tool.
pdftools.detect.title: Detect Fields
pdftools.detect.sub: Finds underlines (____) and boxes (□) and makes text fields and check boxes there.
pdftools.replace.title: Replace Pages
pdftools.replace.sub: Replaces the chosen pages with pages of another PDF.
pdftools.crop.title: Crop Pages
pdftools.crop.sub: Crops by the margins (crop box). The content stays in the file; only the visible area changes.
pdftools.crop.draw: Draw the area on the page
pdftools.labels.title: Page Labels
pdftools.labels.sub: Sets the numbers shown for the pages (i, ii … 1, 2 …).
pdftools.picture.title: Replace Image
pdftools.picture.tip: Click an image on the page to replace it
pdftools.pdfa.title: Save as PDF/A
pdftools.pdfa.sub: Saves a new archive file (PDF/A-2b). The open document does not change.
pdftools.pdfa.what: Adds the PDF/A identification (XMP), an sRGB color profile and a document ID, and removes scripts that run by themselves. Fonts missing from the file cannot be added.
pdftools.pdfa.fonts: {n} fonts are not embedded; a validator may reject the file.
pdftools.compare.title: Compare Files
pdftools.compare.sub: Finds the wording differences between this document and another PDF.
pdftools.compare.count: {n} differences (red: only here, green: only in the other)
pdftools.goto.title: Go to Page
pdftools.props.title: Document Properties
pdftools.props.f.title: Title
pdftools.props.f.author: Author
pdftools.props.f.subject: Subject
pdftools.props.creator: Application
pdftools.rotate.title: Rotate Pages
pdftools.size.fonts: {n} fonts subset to the characters used ({kb} KB smaller).
pdftools.comments.title: Comments
pdftools.state.label: Status
pdftools.measure.tip: Measures distances, perimeters and areas on the page. Drag for a distance; for a perimeter or an area click the points and double-click or press Enter. Esc stops.
pdftools.tags.autoTip: Tags the text as headings and paragraphs so screen readers have a reading order.
pdftools.tags.orderSub: The order a screen reader reads. Click a row to go to its page.
pdftools.tags.none: This file has no tags. Autotag adds them.
pdftools.tags.already: The file is tagged already. Here is its reading order.
